sections.en: The part of fortune is aspected by malefics and by benefics

summary.headline: Rules for Judging Fortune
summary.text: Rules for judging fortune from the part of fortune, triplicity lords, angularity, and planetary aspects. Angular fortunes and benefics indicate prosperity, while cadent triplicity lords, malefics in the eleventh sign or with the part of fortune, and afflicted Moon configurations signify labor or a fall of fortune.
